# Native KLL reader fixtures. Independent BigQuery answers are archived in
# tools/kll/followup.answers.txt, tools/kll/sampler.answers.txt and
# tools/kll/reader.answers.txt.
# Fixed input bytes, not golden expectations for a randomized writer.

SELECT KLL_QUANTILES.EXTRACT_INT64(FROM_HEX('0871100520048a0727088a1710e8071a0afdffffffffffffffff012201092a10120efdffffffffffffffff0102060400'), 8)
=> [{"v":"-3"},{"v":"-3"},{"v":"-1"},{"v":"-1"},{"v":"5"},{"v":"9"},{"v":"9"},{"v":"9"},{"v":"9"}]

# Invalid bytes and type/argument errors: tools/kll/quantiles.answers.txt and
# third_party/bigquery_docs/reference/standard-sql/kll_functions.md.
SELECT KLL_QUANTILES.EXTRACT_FLOAT64(FROM_HEX('0871100120048a0711088a1710e8071a01012201012a03120101'), 2)
=> error: Expected sketch value type FLOAT64 but found INT64 type; error in KLL_QUANTILES.EXTRACT_FLOAT64 expression

SELECT KLL_QUANTILES.EXTRACT_INT64(FROM_HEX('08711001200a8a0726088a1710e8071a08000000000000f03f2208000000000000f03f2a0a0a08000000000000f03f'), 2)
=> error: Expected sketch value type INT64 but found FLOAT64 type; error in KLL_QUANTILES.EXTRACT_INT64 expression

SELECT KLL_QUANTILES.EXTRACT_FLOAT64(FROM_HEX('08711001200a8a0726088a1710e8071a08000000000000f03f2208000000000000f03f2a0a0a08000000000000f03f'), 100001)
=> error: Provided num_quantiles: 100001 but num_quantiles must be in the range [1, 100000]; error in KLL_QUANTILES.EXTRACT_FLOAT64 expression

SELECT KLL_QUANTILES.EXTRACT_INT64(CAST(NULL AS BYTES), 0)
=> error contains: must be at least 1

SELECT KLL_QUANTILES.EXTRACT_INT64(b'bad', CAST(NULL AS INT64))
=> error contains: must be non-NULL

SELECT SAFE.KLL_QUANTILES.EXTRACT_INT64(b'bad', 2)
=> error contains: SAFE with function kll_quantiles.extract_int64 is not supported

SELECT KLL_QUANTILES.EXTRACT_INT64(b'', 2)
=> error: Invalid input sketch bytes; error in KLL_QUANTILES.EXTRACT_INT64 expression

SELECT KLL_QUANTILES.EXTRACT_INT64(b'not a sketch', 2)
=> error contains: Invalid input sketch bytes

SELECT KLL_QUANTILES.EXTRACT_INT64(FROM_HEX('08711001180120048a0711088a1710e8071a01012201012a03120101ff'), 2)
=> error contains: Invalid input sketch bytes

# Reader boundaries answered independently after the initial implementation.
SELECT KLL_QUANTILES.EXTRACT_INT64(CAST(NULL AS BYTES), 2)
=> []

SELECT KLL_QUANTILES.EXTRACT_INT64(CAST(NULL AS BYTES), 100001)
=> error: Provided num_quantiles: 100001 but num_quantiles must be in the range [1, 100000]; error in KLL_QUANTILES.EXTRACT_INT64 expression

SELECT KLL_QUANTILES.EXTRACT_FLOAT64(FROM_HEX('08711001200a8a0726088a1710e8071a08000000000000f87f2208000000000000f87f2a0a0a08000000000000f87f'), 2)
=> [{"v":"NaN"},{"v":"NaN"},{"v":"NaN"}]

SELECT KLL_QUANTILES.EXTRACT_FLOAT64(FROM_HEX('08711001200a8a0726088a1710e8071a08000000000000f0ff2208000000000000f0ff2a0a0a08000000000000f0ff'), 2)
=> [{"v":"-Infinity"},{"v":"-Infinity"},{"v":"-Infinity"}]

SELECT KLL_QUANTILES.EXTRACT_INT64(FROM_HEX('0871100120048a0711088a1710e8071a01012201012a03120101'), n) FROM UNNEST([1, 2]) AS n
=> error: Argument #2 must be constant; error in KLL_QUANTILES.EXTRACT_INT64 expression
